frame: Who: every seller. Carol (clearing out) opens it when the chat icon shows a count; a flipper opens it many times a day.
Came to: send the replies the agent drafted, and see who wrote, on which site, and what waits for them, without opening five apps.
A mistake costs most where an offer runs out unseen, or where a scammer gets an answer.
Ways out (spec/ways-out.md §6.3): show one item's messages; Answer for me can be turned off from the line that opens it; a blocked buyer stays in the list as Blocked.

In the loop: replies start as drafts (ways-out §6.3). The page opens on the replies to send, each with the buyer's words, the exact reply and the facts it states with their sources; nothing goes without Send or Send all.

decisions.decision: The page opens on "N replies to send", one at a time like a queue card
decisions.why: ways-out §6.3, "Let me approve replies fast" (Ben, 05:18): replies start as drafts the person approves.

decisions.decision: Each reply shows the buyer's words, the exact reply, and a chip per fact with where it came from
decisions.why: So the person checks the source, not only the sentence (ways-out §6.3).

decisions.decision: Send, Edit, Take over on the card; Send all only for replies whose every fact is confirmed and unedited
decisions.why: ways-out §6.3: Send all is for replies that only state confirmed facts. Take over opens the thread to write it myself.

decisions.decision: The foot line says "Draft for me is on" when nothing was sent for the person this week
decisions.why: Draft for me is the default for a new person (ways-out §6.3); the line opens the setting.

decisions.decision: Every site in one list, newest first
decisions.why: Mail and iMessage order an inbox this way, and decision "All messages live behind a chat icon with a count" puts every site here.

decisions.decision: Each row carries the site's square logo on the item's photo
decisions.why: The photo says which thing, the logo which site; a site's name is never written as words (kit, SiteBadge).

decisions.decision: An unread count, not a dot
decisions.why: The brief asks for the count, and it matches the count on the chat icon in the nav.

decisions.decision: A row says what waits (Offer, Reply, Pickup, Possible scam) or what the agent did (Sent for you)
decisions.why: So the list itself shows who acts next, without opening each thread.

decisions.decision: A line at the foot counts what was sent for the person this week and opens the setting
decisions.why: What the agent did stays visible and reversible (ways-out, "Stop doing that for me").

decisions.decision: The filter is a sheet of items, offered only when more than one item has messages
decisions.why: One item has nothing to filter; a sheet holds a long list of titles.

states.why: a person with no sites connected
five conversations across sites, two replies drafted, one flagged as a possible scam
the list did not load; Try again asks again
the last copy, with Send held and Send all hidden until the signal returns

skips.loading: a thread row has no skeleton in the kit yet, and a card skeleton would move the list when it lands
skips.dense: no world holds more than five conversations, and a longer list is the same rows

controls.does: goes back, or to Today when opened directly
opens the sheet of items to show one
opens the thread flagged as a possible scam
opens the Answer for me setting and what it sent
opens the thread the reply answers
keeps the edit; changed words turn solid
sends this reply and shows the next
opens the thread to write it myself
sends every reply that states only confirmed facts

back: Back goes to the screen it came from; opened directly, to Today.
